criteria.criterion: A single criterion's LLMBudgetExhaustedError no longer aborts recovery: with N criteria and one evidence run exhausting, the finalizer still runs and receives N evidence entries, the exhausted one carrying an explicit could-not-gather-within-bounds placeholder (unit test, held-out oracle style).
A RunawayToolLoopError raised by an evidence run is handled the same way (unit test).
A token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError from an evidence run is converted to the exhausted placeholder, mirroring the primary path; a NON-token UnretryableOutputError still propagates (unit test).
The placeholder is content-free (no exception prose interpolated beyond the failure class name and numeric usage counters) and can never read as affirmative evidence (unit test asserts wording).
If EVERY criterion's evidence run fails, recovery raises CompletionRecoveryError with diagnostic {criteria_total, criteria_exhausted} (unit test).
Successful-evidence behaviour is byte-identical: runs where no evidence agent fails produce the same finalizer input as before (unit test).

Live Bedrock proof before ship: a real gate-style recovery over multiple criteria where at least one evidence run exhausts completes with a verdict instead of failing whole (session experiment, not in unit suite).
